nom: The Ordinary Aloe 2% + NAG 2% Solution for Post-Acne Marks

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin generally report reduced blemishes, faded marks and less redness, with a few noting a slight oily sheen or that less product avoids that.
segments.dry: One reviewer with drier, flake-prone skin found this lightweight serum eliminated flakiness and balanced her skin without needing a heavier cream on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed results, from clearing and lightweight comfort to one case of a bad breakout.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers describe the serum as calming and non-irritating for redness and post-acne marks, but a minority report burning, redness or breakouts on their sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer using it alongside a wrinkle-support serum reports smoother skin, though she notes she has no wrinkles to compare against.

concerns.aging: A single reviewer pairing this with a wrinkle-support serum reports smoother skin, but does not attribute this specifically to the Aloe+NAG product.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as moisturizing, hydrating or plumping, with one saying it removed the need for a separate moisturizer, though one reviewer found it no more hydrating than any other serum.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report a clear reduction in redness, particularly around post-acne marks and inflammation, with effects sometimes noticed within days; a couple report no change in their usual redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the serum with repairing a compromised or flaky skin barrier and reducing associated redness; this is a recurring specific praise rather than a general one.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report fading or lightening of post-acne marks and dark spots, sometimes within one to two weeks, though a few say marks stayed the same or only lighter ones faded while darker scars did not.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including those with cystic acne, report fewer new breakouts and faster healing of existing blemishes; however, several reviewers report new or worsened breakouts, pore-clogging or no change to acne.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers note the product does not feel greasy or oily despite being labeled for dry skin, though one reviewer noted an oily sheen requiring her to use less.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky as it dries
Layers well under makeup or moisturizer

extraits.titre: Sensitive skin users don't take this risk
extraits.texte: Do NOT recommend this product. I have been using the ordinary for years, it's great that they are coming out with new stuff but not when it doesn't work for you. Most of the reviews here were from influencers that were given this product for free sadly. I had high hopes being a avid TO user. However, this product broke my skin out. I now have chemical burns! Also caused redness. Now I have to re-fix the damage. Not for everyday use!!!!

This serum is so good. I have been using it for the past month and a half, and I have noticed a huge difference in my skin's overall texture. My pores are less noticeable in my T-zone, and my skin is a lot smoother. I have very oily, acne-prone skin, and I also saw an improvement in blemishes! I usually get large cystic bumps on my chin and neck, and it seemed to allow the ones I had to go down and heal and keep new ones at bay. The aloe was also very soothing! Because of my cystic acne, my skin is usually red and inflamed, so this helped a lot. If you also suffer from cystic acne, give this a try!! p.s. I will say I went through this product fairly quickly. It says to apply a few drops morning and evening, so I went with 2-3 twice daily. I'm not sure if my drops were just large ones, but I ran out of this product about two months in. So keep that in mind! But I don't mind rebuying it so soon because it really has changed my skin!

I got this a bit ago and I used it for 8 weeks just to see what it would do, I struggled with scarring, redness, texture, and a broken skin barrier. This serum didn't really help with the the darker scarring, but it definitely did help with the lighter and smaller spots here and there. Completely fixed my skin barrier, and therefore also fixed my redness (one issue came from the other) I'M TELLING YOU I GOT SO MANY COMPLIMENTS. My skin texture also definitely improved a lot, my skin feels a whole lot smoother. Not only did this serum work wonders but it's also super moisturizing and leaves the skin with a satin finish. Love it.

So here's the deal… I've battled with my skin barrier for a long time, years and years. Most often I had oily skin with a gritty feeling and surface flakiness and minor redness (not rosacea but eczema). Most serums never worked on their own for me, always needed to layer heavier cream on top but that always made me feel too greasy and didn't properly penetrate my skin. When wearing makeup it always looked ok first but then started to flake and look bad later, especially on my forehead which has always been drier than the rest of my face. I've used this for about a month now and I'm blown away on how comfortable, smooth and balanced my skin feels, without needing other creams on top. All flakiness is gone, my skin tone is even and I don't feel at all self conscious when wearing makeup or the need to check if I look flakey or not. Honestly this has to be a staple for everyone. Not just "dry skin" as it's SO SO lightweight and water based. The best thing you can do for your skin is to maintain a healthy barrier, and this serum does exactly that. PS. I don't have bad acne marks but the tiny one or two I used to have are also faded without me realizing.

I have sensitive skin so unfortunately this serum didn't work out for me It was leaving my face red and burning I really wish it had worked out because other skin care products from this line worked great on my skin

I start my first routine with TO by using HA because is the most popular product and advertised a lot. Unfortunately wasn't matched with my skin. This happened in 2020. I had very sensitive skin with blemish probes and black heads, lack of hydration. After 1 bottle which I tried to used in many ways my conclusion was and is still actual: Hyaluronic acid is note suitable for my skin. I love Buffer plus copper but because of HA is make me a lot of headache. So, I replace with Amino Acid+B5 and my skin was changed straight and almost of blemish gone. I tried Niacinamide to help with my pores but was tooooo much, was fell like a mask. Long time I was waiting for the same target but for dry skin ❤️. I used first bottle in less than 5 weeks. Since was able to buy in O.Lab. This product plumb my skin and I had really spot-off skin when I used it. Have a really light fragrance which is come off very quickly but I like it and I observed less dark spot on my nose. With a texture like HA but is not the same. Under face cream and makeup is perfect. Just an amazing product.

extraits.titre: Perfect daily day time acne serum
extraits.texte: Dries quickly, can be used daily on acne prone skin. I'm using it during summer months and don't find it makes my skin greasy even though says for dry skin and I have combination. I just wish it came in the larger format like some of the other serums!
